//: NightStrix camera manifest — the normalized, vendor-neutral camera model.
//id: Logical camera id used by consumers (get_snapshot("backyard")). Opaque handle.
//display_name: Human label shown in the UI.
//provider: Internal adapter name (nightowl, rtsp, onvif, rpi, ...). NOT exposed to downstream agents.
//capabilities: What NightStrix can actually deliver for this camera (queryable by ability, not by vendor).
//streams: Logical role -> go2rtc stream NAME (defined in go2rtc.yaml). Never a URL, never credentials.
//note: Credentials and RTSP URLs live ONLY in go2rtc.yaml. This file must contain no secrets.
